verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer explicitly represents both company/founder-side clients (thousands of startups, SAFEs, pre-seed through late-stage financings) and fund/investor-side clients ('we represent more venture funds than any other law firm'), plus is ranked the most active VC law firm globally with deep deal volume on both sides, giving clear both-sides-of-the-table market visibility.
